title: Red Pasta
howToPrepare:
Ingredients:

     Pasta shell

        onion

        tomatoes

        cashew nut

        red chiil

        vegetable of choice 

        Italian seasoning

        paneer

        milk

        salt

        how to prepare:
        first in a pan add some pasta add water salt and boil until it becomes soft. In another   pan add some oil and fry some onion
        garlic, red chillies, paneer,cashews, italian seasoning fry for few minutes when it cool down add it into grinder and grind it into soft paste
        in a same pan add 2 tablespoon butter and mix the ground paste fry for 5 seconds then add the fried vegetables then add boiled
        pasta adjust the consistency and serve it hot.
